text: 进行理智检定：成功则判定你曾遭受暂时性精神错乱——这意味着你将被驱逐出境并蒙受耻辱；失败则你会被视为精神病罪犯。等你获释时，已无人记得你的名字，也没人记得你那些说辞。纳德尔曼探险队就此结束。全书完。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 105
text: Make a Sanity roll: if you succeed, you are judged to have suffered from temporary insanity—which means deportation and disgrace; if you fail, you are considered a psychotic criminal. By the time you are freed, no one remembers your name nor your claims. The Nadelmann Expedition is over. THE END.
